input: Download and learn a new chord progression app

gold.taskTitle: Download and Learn a Chord Progression App
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find, download, and learn how to use a new app focused on chord progressions for music practice or composition.

questions.title: Which instrument do you primarily play or compose for?
questions.description: Understanding the instrument helps narrow down which chord progression apps are most relevant.

questions.title: What device or platform will you install the app on?
questions.description: Knowing whether it is iOS, Android, desktop, or browser-based determines where to search and download.

questions.title: What is your current level of music theory knowledge?
questions.description: Beginner, intermediate, or advanced level shapes which app features will be useful and how deep the learning curve should be.

questions.title: Do you already have a specific app name in mind?
questions.description: If the user has heard of a particular app, this avoids unnecessary research and goes straight to setup and learning.

questions.title: Is your main goal practice, composition, or theory study?
questions.description: The purpose behind using the app determines which features matter most, such as playback, ear training, or songwriting tools.

questions.title: Are you open to paid apps or only free ones?
questions.description: Budget preference filters the available options and affects which apps can be recommended or pursued.

questions.title: By when do you want to feel comfortable using the app?
questions.description: A target deadline or timeframe helps structure how much time to dedicate to learning the app each day or week.
